  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindOutResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriority</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddPrerequisites</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_MaterialsUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Outcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Join_Outcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BotFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_GameSystem" name="Game system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolsRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecoverFromDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_MilestoneReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyPlayer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateBot" name="Bot creation started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FindOutResources" name="Find out which resources you want (up to 10)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriority" name="Set urgency of selected resources"/>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ResolveDependencies" name="Resolve tool dependencies of selected resources"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolsRequired" name="Tools required by other resources?" default="Flow_NoPrerequisites"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddPrerequisites" name="Add resources required for tools"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Farming" name="Farming start or resume"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherResources" name="Gather selected resources in parallel (up to 10)">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_NaturalDisaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecoverFromDisaster" name="Recover bot from disaster setback"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_MilestoneReached" messageRef="Message_MilestoneReached"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyPlayer" name="Notify player of reached milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MilestoneNotified" name="Player notified"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateRequest" name="Update request received" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_UpdateMaterials" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterialsList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MaterialsUpdated" name="Materials list updated"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Bot finished: brag and/or send materials?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Join_Outcome" name="Outcome join"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BotFinished" name="Bot finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToFind" sourceRef="Start_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_FindOutResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FindToPriority" sourceRef="Task_FindOutResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriority"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PriorityToResolve" sourceRef="Task_SetPriority" targetRef="Task_ResolveDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolveToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ResolveDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_ToolsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrerequisitesNeeded" name="Prerequisites missing" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolsRequired" targetRef="Task_AddPrerequisites">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${prerequisitesMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddToResolve" sourceRef="Task_AddPrerequisites" targetRef="Task_ResolveDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPrerequisites" name="No prerequisites missing" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolsRequired" targetRef="Merge_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingToGather" sourceRef="Merge_Farming" targetRef="Task_GatherResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_GatherResources" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisasterToRecover" sourceRef="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverFromDisaster"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecoverToFarming" sourceRef="Task_RecoverFromDisaster" targetRef="Merge_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneToNotify" sourceRef="Boundary_MilestoneReached" targetRef="Task_NotifyPlayer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPlayer" targetRef="End_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateRequestToUpdate" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterialsList" targetRef="End_MaterialsUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BragSelected" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendSelected" name="Materials to send" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${materialsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BragToJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Join_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Join_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Join_Outcome" targetRef="End_BotFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
